ruleName: Build must be green — nx build exit 0 required
lineContent: Build state verified by audit-orchestrator post-hoc, not by this handler
suggestedFix: Read the build error output. Resolve every error TS####, Cannot find module, duplicate-export, and Errors while compiling. Re-run the build until exit 0. Do not bundle the fix with new feature work.
